user_query: I'm organizing a company event and I need to order custom t-shirts for all the employees. Can you recommend some reliable t-shirt printing services? Additionally, provide me with the pricing details and customer reviews for each service.

TaskList.description: Research and identify reliable t-shirt printing services.
Gather pricing details for the identified t-shirt printing services.
Retrieve customer reviews for the identified t-shirt printing services.
Compile all pricing details and customer reviews into a summary document.
